title: 第2章 废物功法
content_zh:
当海天刚刚跨进珍海阁的大门时，一直站立于门口的海无涯忽然低声说道：“天儿，在第三排书架的第五层上，有一部黄阶高级的修炼功法。”

说完，便抬起头来，好像什么事都没有发生过似的。

海天却是莫名的点了点头。按照道理来讲，所有功法的选择都是由自己去选择的，无论级别高低，一旦选中就不能反悔。可海无涯却是冒着一定的风险告诉海天最好的选择，不得不说海无涯对他真得很不错。

“谢谢父亲。”海天的心底流过一丝暖流，在上一世中，他本就是孤儿，从未体会过亲情。这一世来到海家，倒也是感受到了亲情的温暖。

听到海天的回应，海无涯的脸上也是挂起了一丝淡淡的笑容，“好了，快去吧，别让别人给先拿走了。”

“天哥！你还站在门口做什么？赶快进来呀，这里有好多修炼功法，看得我都眼花缭乱了！”小雨早已被这珍海阁里面的一排排书架所吸引，本想和海天讨论一下功法的选择问题，哪知一转身却发现海天依然在门口，便高声叫了起来。

对此，海天则是微微笑了笑，立即走上前去。只是他并没有去走向海无涯指点他的第三排书架，而是向小雨走去。

黄阶功法？这或许对普通人来说还是相当不错的，可是对于他来说却是没有任何意义。

在这片魂剑大陆上，人们修炼的并非是那些魔法和斗气，反而修炼的是剑！

一个人的强弱，最主要的是取决于自身的实力。比如说海天，就曾经是站在整个魂剑大陆顶点的剑神级别的高手。可并不是说，每一个人都有机会修炼到剑神。

想要修炼到剑神，除了拥有极好的天赋外，最为重要的就是修炼功法了。

经过数万年来的发展，人们早已将修炼繁衍到了巅峰，并且分成了许多种方法。这也就造成了拥有许多不同级别的功法存在。

人们将修炼功法分为天，地，玄，黄四个级别。而每一个级别又分为初，中，高三个小级别。先前海无涯口中所说的黄阶高级，便是黄阶功法中最为厉害的一种了。

在整个魂剑大陆上，黄阶级别的功法是最为普遍的，大部分的修炼者们便是修炼的这种级别的功法。可是黄阶级别的功法局限性太大，修炼速度又慢，想要修炼到剑神，几乎不可能。

玄阶级别的功法，在魂剑大陆上则是比较少见了，一般只有一些较大的势力才可能拥有。

地阶级别的功法，比玄阶的还要希罕许多，仅有那些超级大势力会拥有。

至于最后的天阶功法，已经许多年都没有出现过了。至于是否存在，也已经成为了魂剑大陆上一个解不开的迷题。

过去海天修炼的便是一本地阶中级的修炼功法，所以对于海无涯所说的黄阶初级功法，他根本就看不上眼。不过因为海无涯对他的关心，他倒也没有直接拒绝。

“天哥！你快看，这里有好多种修炼功法，你说我们要选哪一本好呢？”小雨兴奋的犹如一只刚出笼小鸟，唧唧喳喳的叫个不停。

“小雨，这些修炼功法都是分属性的，你最好按照自己身体属性来选择，这样才会达到最好的效果。”海天说到这里顿了顿，“你是风属性的，最好选一本风系的功法来配合。”

“风系的功法吗？”小雨的眉头紧皱了起来，目光在那一排排的书架上不断的徘徊着，看样子心里也正在做着选择。

见小雨一直在沉吟，海天也没有陪在他身边，反而是在这偌大的珍海阁第一层中随意游逛了起来。

就在刚才那简短的时间内，他已经发现了这第一层的修炼功法基本全是黄阶级别的。连一本玄阶级别的功法都没有。能够拥有那样神奇禁制的海家，会没有一本玄阶级别的功法吗？反正海天是不会相信的，肯定藏在了别的地方，比如说这第二层上。

和他们一起进来的那些个旁系子弟们，一个个都兴奋的挑选着。恐怕这次前来挑选功法的众人中，只有海天一人会如此的悠闲。

忽然，一本修炼功法陡然进入了海天的视线内。

《九天神剑诀》便是这本修炼功法的名称。

海天的心立即砰砰然的快速跳跃了起来，呼吸也变得相当的急促。伸出颤巍巍的右手从书架上将这本修炼功法给抽了出来：“不会是真的吧？”

小心翼翼的拍了拍上面布满了灰尘的书籍，《九天神剑诀》几个字样立即清晰起来，海天的瞳孔立即瞪得老大，他不断的在心里狂吼着：“这怎么可能！这怎么可能！这可是当年纵横魂剑大陆的九天剑神所修炼的超级功法，怎么可能会出现在一个小小的海家内？”

九天剑神是几千年前的一名剑神，当时在整个魂剑大陆上无人不知，无人不晓。传说他当时已经修炼到了最高级别的九星剑神，可以说是古往今来魂剑大陆第一剑神！

然而，他后来便神秘消失了，只留下了他修炼的功法《九天神剑诀》。

对于九天剑神的消失，很多人纷纷猜测不已，有的人认为九天剑神已经超越了九星剑神，到另一个世界去了，也有的人认为九天剑神已经死了。

一时间众说纷纭，不过不管这九天剑神到底哪里去了，他遗留下来的《九天神剑诀》却是当时魂剑大陆上每一个人都渴望得到的秘宝。

经过一系列激烈的大战，这本神奇的功法《九天神剑诀》却也是消失不见了。自此以后，便再也没有在魂剑大陆上出现过，可谁能想到竟然会在一个小小的海家出现？

“呼呼！”海天的心情激动万分，要知道这《九天神剑诀》可是天阶高级的功法，比他当年的那本地阶中级的功法好上太多了。

可是问题紧接着来了，海家拥有如此宝贝，怎么可能这么多年过去了还是一个小家族？

带着强烈的好奇心，海天立即仔细的翻阅起来。很快他便发现，这本九天神剑诀只是一个不完整的版本。可是即便如此的话，光凭这前半部，修炼到剑皇级别也完全没有问题。

而海家最强者，也就是海天的父亲海无涯，才仅仅是五星大剑师而已，怎么会差那么多？

在魂剑大陆上，人们将修炼者们统称为剑者，而剑者也是分等级的。第一等级为剑士，其次分别为剑师，大剑师，剑王，剑皇，剑宗，剑尊，剑圣以及剑神。

想不通，实在是想不通！海天困扰的摇了摇脑袋，当年九天剑神名震整个魂剑大陆，海家的前辈不可能不知道，可是他们却为什么没有修炼？

“大家都选好了没？如果选好了话，拿到我这边来登记！”海无涯的声音陡然响了起来，打断了海天的思绪。

一时间，那些个已经选好了修炼功法的旁系子弟们，一个个都兴奋的走到了出口处，将自己的功法拿了出来，让海无涯进行登记。

“天哥！天哥，你选好了吗？”小雨立即奔跑了过来，而且手里还拿着一本青色封皮的修炼功法，“天哥，你看，这是我选的《青风诀》！”

“不错，这可是一本黄阶高级的功法，小雨，你眼力劲可真不错。”海天由衷的赞扬了一句，要知道这些修炼功法上可不会写明了功法的等级，一切都由自己去判断。

然而，小雨却是出人意料的低着头，怯生生的说道：“天哥，我告诉你哦，这可是我父亲让我选的功法。他说这里大部分功法只是黄阶初级，仅有少部分黄阶高级的存在。”

听了这话，海天不禁莞尔，看样子这公平也只是表面上的。身为海家直系子弟的他们，永远都要比那些旁系子弟的待遇好上一些。

“咦？天哥，你怎么选择的这本功法？”当小雨望见海天所选择的修炼功法，惊讶的挑了挑眉毛。

“怎么？难道我不能选择吗？”海天奇怪的皱起了眉头。

小雨摇了摇脑袋：“这倒不是。算了，我也说不清楚，不过我想大伯等会儿肯定会阻止你选择这本修炼功法的。”

对于小雨的话，海天的心中却是升起了一个大大的问号，不过却是直接向着门口走了过去。

他前面的那些个旁系子弟们，都正在将自己选择的功法递给海无涯进行登记。而且海无涯也不断的进行着点评着，告诉他们这修炼功法的等级。

很可惜，大部分人选择的都是黄阶初级的修炼功法，仅有两人选择的是黄阶中级的。这让那两人极为的欣喜。

果然如小雨所说的那样，海无涯一见海天所选择的修炼功法，立即跳了起来，瞪大着眼睛：“天儿！你怎么选择这本功法？”

“难道不行吗？不是说功法是任选的吗？”海天奇怪的将目光锁定在了海无涯的脸上。

海无涯心里很是气恼，海天竟然没有听从他的话，去选择那本黄阶高级的修炼功法。不过当着这么多人的面，他也不好说什么，只是叹息一声：“天儿，再给你个机会，去重新选择一本吧。”

“父亲，这本功法到底有什么古怪的，你为什么不让我选？”

海无涯望了一眼倔强的海天，发现众人的目光都放在他的身上，无奈的叹了口气：“好吧，既然你想知道，那么我就告诉你。你选的这本《九天神剑诀》，是一本天阶功法！”

“天阶功法？”在场的众人全部惊叫起来，很多人甚至怀疑自己听错了。天阶功法少说几百上千年没有出现过了。

早已知道《九天神剑诀》底细的海天并没有太多的惊讶，这让一直注意他的海无涯稍稍诧异了一些。
content_en:
When Hai Tian just stepped into the gate of Zhenhai Pavilion, Hai Wuya, who had been standing at the door, suddenly whispered: "Tian'er, on the fifth floor of the third row of bookshelves, there is a Huang-level advanced cultivation technique."

After saying that, he raised his head as if nothing had happened.

Hai Tian nodded inexplicably.Logically speaking, the choice of all exercises is yours. No matter the level, you cannot regret it once you choose it.But Hai Wuya took a certain risk to tell Hai Tian the best choice. I have to say that Hai Wuya was really good to him.

"Thank you, father." A warm current flowed through Hai Tian's heart. In his previous life, he was an orphan and had never experienced family affection.When I came to the Hai family in this life, I felt the warmth of family affection.

Hearing Hai Tian's response, Hai Wuya also had a faint smile on his face, "Okay, go quickly, don't let others take it away first."

"Brother Tian! What are you doing standing at the door? Come in quickly. There are so many cultivation techniques here that I'm dazzled!" Xiao Yu had already been attracted by the rows of bookshelves in Zhenhai Pavilion. She wanted to discuss the selection of techniques with Hai Tian, but when she turned around, she found that Hai Tian was still at the door and shouted loudly.

In response, Hai Tian smiled slightly and immediately stepped forward.But instead of walking towards the third row of bookshelves where Hai Wuya pointed him, he walked towards Xiao Yu.

Huang Jie Kung Fu?This may be quite good for ordinary people, but it means nothing to him.

In this Soul Sword Continent, what people practice is not magic and fighting spirit, but swords!

A person's strength mainly depends on his own strength.For example, Hai Tian was once a sword god-level master who stood at the top of the entire Soul Sword Continent.But it doesn't mean that everyone has the opportunity to become a sword god.

If you want to become a swordsman, in addition to having excellent talent, the most important thing is to practice skills.

After tens of thousands of years of development, people have already reached the peak of cultivation and divided it into many methods.This also results in the existence of many different levels of skills.

People divide the cultivation methods into four levels: Heaven, Earth, Xuan, and Huang.Each level is divided into three sub-levels: Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced.The advanced Huang Jie skills that Hai Wuya mentioned earlier are the most powerful among the Huang Jie skills.

In the entire Soul Sword Continent, the Huang class skills are the most common, and most practitioners practice this level of skills.However, the Huang class skills are too limited and the cultivation speed is slow. It is almost impossible to become a sword god.

Xuanjia level skills are relatively rare in the Soul Sword Continent, and generally only some larger forces can possess them.

The skills of the earth class are much rarer than those of the mysterious class, and only those super powerful forces possess them.

As for the final heaven-level technique, it has not appeared for many years.As for whether it exists, it has become an unsolvable mystery on the Soul Sword Continent.

In the past, Hai Tian practiced a local-level intermediate cultivation method, so he didn't like the Huang-level elementary skills mentioned by Hai Wuya at all.However, because of Hai Wuya's concern for him, he did not refuse directly.

"Brother Tian! Look, there are many kinds of cultivation techniques here. Which one do you think we should choose?" Xiaoyu was as excited as a bird just out of the cage, chirping non-stop.

"Xiao Yu, these training techniques are all divided into attributes. You'd better choose according to your own physical attributes, so as to achieve the best effect." Hai Tian paused at this point, "You are of the wind attribute, so it's best to choose a wind attribute technique to match."

"Wind-type skills?" Xiao Yu's brows furrowed, her eyes lingering on the rows of bookshelves, and it seemed that she was making a choice in her heart.

Seeing that Xiaoyu had been brooding, Haitian did not accompany him. Instead, he wandered around the first floor of the huge Zhenhai Pavilion.

In the short period of time just now, he had already discovered that the first level of cultivation techniques were basically all of the yellow level.There is not even a book of Xuanpo level exercises.Wouldn't the Hai family, which possesses such a magical restriction, not have a Mystical Level skill?Hai Tian wouldn't believe it anyway, he must be hiding somewhere else, such as on the second floor.

The sideline disciples who came in with them were all excitedly choosing.I'm afraid that among the people who came here to choose the exercises this time, only Hai Tian would be so leisurely.

Suddenly, a book of cultivation techniques came into Hai Tian's sight.

"Nine Heavens Divine Sword Technique" is the name of this practice method.

Hai Tian's heart immediately jumped rapidly, and his breathing became quite rapid.He stretched out his trembling right hand and pulled out the practice book from the bookshelf: "It can't be true, can it?"

Carefully patting the dusty book on it, the words "Nine Heavens Sword Art" became clear immediately. Hai Tian's pupils immediately widened. He kept yelling in his heart: "How is this possible! How is this possible! This is the super technique practiced by the Nine Heavens Sword God who dominated the Soul Sword Continent. How could it appear in a small Hai family?"

The Nine Heavens Sword God was a sword god thousands of years ago. At that time, everyone in the entire Soul Sword Continent knew about him.Legend has it that he had already reached the highest level of Nine-Star Sword God at that time, and could be said to be the number one sword god in the Soul Sword Continent throughout the ages!

However, he mysteriously disappeared later, leaving behind only the "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Technique" he practiced.

Many people have speculated about the disappearance of the Nine-Heaven Sword God. Some people think that the Nine-Heaven Sword God has surpassed the Nine-Star Sword God and gone to another world. Some people think that the Nine-Heaven Sword God is dead.

There were different opinions for a while, but no matter where the Nine Heavens Sword God went, the "Nine Heavens Sword Art" he left behind was the secret treasure that everyone on the Soul Sword Continent longed to obtain at that time.

After a series of fierce battles, this magical skill "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art" also disappeared.Since then, he has never appeared on the Soul Sword Continent again, but who would have thought that he would appear in a small Haijia?

"Huhu!" Hai Tian was extremely excited. You must know that this "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art" is a high-level heaven-level skill, which is much better than the local-level intermediate skill he used back then.

But the question came immediately. With such a treasure, how could the Hai family still be a small family after so many years?

With strong curiosity, Hai Tian immediately started reading it carefully.He soon discovered that this Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art was only an incomplete version.But even so, with this first half alone, there is no problem in cultivating to the Sword King level.

And the strongest person in the Hai family, Hai Tian's father, Hai Wuya, is only a five-star great swordsman. How could he be so different?

On the Soul Sword Continent, people collectively refer to practitioners as swordsmen, and swordsmen are also divided into levels.The first level is Swordsman, followed by Sword Master, Great Sword Master, Sword King, Sword Emperor, Sword Sect, Sword Master, Sword Saint and Sword God.

I can’t figure it out, I really can’t figure it out!Hai Tian shook his head in confusion. Back then, the Nine Heavens Sword God was famous throughout the Soul Sword Continent. It was impossible for the seniors of the Hai family not to know about it, but why didn't they practice?

"Has everyone made their choices? If so, come to me to register!" Hai Wuya's voice suddenly sounded, interrupting Hai Tian's thoughts.

For a moment, the disciples who had already chosen the exercises to practice excitedly walked to the exit, took out their own exercises, and asked Hai Wuya to register them.

"Brother Tian! Brother Tian, have you made your choice?" Xiaoyu immediately ran over, holding a blue-covered practice book in his hand, "Brother Tian, look, this is the "Qingfeng Jue" I chose!"

"Yes, this is a high-level Huang-level skill book. Xiaoyu, you have really good eyesight." Hai Tian praised it sincerely. You must know that the level of the skill is not written on these training skills. Everything is judged by yourself.

However, Xiao Yu unexpectedly lowered his head and said timidly: "Brother Tian, let me tell you, this is the technique my father asked me to choose. He said that most of the techniques here are only elementary Huang level, and only a few are advanced Huang level."

After hearing this, Hai Tian couldn't help but smile. It seemed that this fairness was only superficial.As direct descendants of the Hai family, they will always be treated better than those from collateral descendants.

"Eh? Brother Tian, ​​how did you choose this exercise method?" When Xiaoyu saw the exercise method chosen by Hai Tian, ​​he raised his eyebrows in surprise.

"What? Can't I choose?" Hai Tian frowned strangely.

Xiaoyu shook his head: "That's not true. Forget it, I can't tell clearly, but I think your uncle will definitely stop you from choosing this practice book later."

Regarding Xiao Yu's words, Hai Tian had a big question mark in his heart, but he walked directly towards the door.

The collateral disciples in front of him were handing the exercises of their choice to Hai Wuya for registration.Moreover, Hai Wuya also continued to comment and tell them the level of this practice.

It's a pity that most people choose the basic Huang-level cultivation techniques, and only two people choose the intermediate Huang-level ones.This made the two people extremely happy.

Sure enough, as Xiao Yu said, when Hai Wuya saw the practice method chosen by Hai Tian, he immediately jumped up and widened his eyes: "Tian'er! Why did you choose this method?"

"Isn't it possible? Didn't it say that the exercises are optional?" Hai Tian strangely fixed his gaze on Hai Wuya's face.

Hai Wuya was very angry because Hai Tian didn't listen to his words and choose the Huang-level advanced cultivation technique.But in front of so many people, he couldn't say anything. He just sighed: "Tian'er, I'll give you another chance to choose another book."

"Father, what's so weird about this technique? Why don't you let me choose?"

Hai Wuya glanced at the stubborn Hai Tian and found that everyone's eyes were on him. He sighed helplessly: "Okay, since you want to know, then I will tell you. The book "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art" you chose is a heaven-level skill book!"

"Heaven level skills?" Everyone present screamed in shock, and many people even suspected that they heard it wrong.Heaven level skills have not appeared for at least hundreds of thousands of years.

Hai Tian, ​​who already knew the details of "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art", was not too surprised. This made Hai Wuya, who had been paying attention to him, a little surprised.
